note: How much each category's weekly result is luck. Measured on Hoops 2025 (466.l.43113), 2025-26 regular season, the 16 seven-day weeks, 10 teams. sdTeams is the spread of teams' true weekly means (observed spread less the part weekly noise explains); sdWeekly is a team's week-to-week spread; r = sqrt(2) * sdWeekly / sdTeams is the noise in a head-to-head difference measured in units of the spread between teams. Lower r means a stronger team wins the category more reliably. Weekly totals include streaming volume, so games-played swings are part of the noise, as they are in the league.
